report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-20 at approximately 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC), mutual fund orders on mf-order-service experienced an elevated error rate of ~6.3%, predominantly affecting SIP orders. Investigation revealed that deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) rolled out via legacy-jenkins-mum at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introduced a regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee, which threw unhandled NullPointerExceptions for folios lacking nominee records. The on-call SRE initially dismissed the deployment because legacy-jenkins-mum logged timestamps without an explicit timezone offset, leading the team to misinterpret 09:20 local time as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST).
report.rootCauseStatement: Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service (version 4.1.0) at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introduced nominee validation logic for SIP orders that fails with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever an existing folio has no associated nominee record.

hypotheses.cause: mf-order-service release v4.1.0 (CHG-48219: nominee validation for SIP orders) introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without a nominee record.
hypotheses.rationale: Deployment CHG-48219 took place at 09:20:00 IST (03:50:00 UTC). Exactly two minutes later at 03:52:07 UTC, mf-order-service v4.1.0 began logging HTTP 500 errors stating 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' across 1,293 instances, driving error rate from 0.3% to ~6.3%.

hypotheses.cause: Upstream RTA API degradation or slow acknowledgements are causing SIP order submission failures.
hypotheses.rationale: RTA logs showed only routine slow acknowledgement warnings and cut-off notifications without submission error surges. The order failures are internal 500 errors caused by local NullPointerExceptions before or during validation, not upstream network or API failures.

facts.statement: Deployment CHG-48219 for mf-order-service updated version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0 ('release: nominee validation for SIP orders') via legacy-jenkins-mum with timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 (tz: 'none').

Between 03:52:07 UTC and 10:14:53 UTC, mf-order-service logged 1,293 HTTP 500 errors with message 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)', all emitting from version 4.1.0.
mf-order-service error_rate rose from baseline ~0.30% to 2.71% at 03:45 UTC and settled at ~6.30% - 6.32% from 04:00 UTC onwards.
Downstream payment and debit services (bank-connector, debit-worker, mandate-service, payment-service) maintained baseline error rates between 0.4% and 1.0% with no spikes.
api-gateway routes for /v1/sip and /v1/orders showed no elevated error rate and maintained baseline between 0.25% and 0.40%.

inferences.statement: The legacy-jenkins-mum deployer recorded the deployment timestamp in local IST (09:20:00 IST = 03:50:00 UTC) without a timezone offset, which the SRE mistakenly interpreted as UTC (14:50 IST), leading to prematurely ruling out the deployment.
The failure is strictly isolated to SIP orders placed against existing folios lacking nominee records, while lumpsum purchases and redemptions remain unaffected.

assumptions.statement: legacy-jenkins-mum host clock operates on Asia/Kolkata (IST, UTC+05:30) time.

timeline.event: mf-order-service deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) completed by legacy-jenkins-mum.
First observed NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee on mf-order-service v4.1.0.
mf-order-service error_rate metric escalates to ~6.30% steady state.
Incident INC-9077 opened by on-call SRE; deployment was mistakenly ruled out due to timestamp confusion.

confidence.rationale: Direct log stack traces show v4.1.0 throwing NullPointerExceptions in the exact nominee validation feature shipped in CHG-48219, starting two minutes after deploy completion.

gaps.description: Commit diff for build-60433 / CHG-48219 could not be directly inspected via git tool.
gaps.impact: Low; the error message explicitly names FolioValidator.validateNominee and identifies the null nominee record on folio objects.

recommendedActions.action: Roll back mf-order-service to version 4.0.7 immediately or hotfix FolioValidator.validateNominee to handle null nominee records gracefully.
recommendedActions.rationale: Restores SIP order placement functionality for folios without nominee data.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor mf-order-service error_rate metric to confirm it drops from 6.3% back to ~0.3%, and verify error logs cease.

recommendedActions.action: Configure legacy-jenkins-mum to emit ISO-8601 timestamps with explicit timezone offsets (+05:30 or Z).
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents incident responders from misinterpreting local deployment times as UTC.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect change record metadata in get_changes for future builds from legacy-jenkins-mum.

recommendedActions.action: Add regression unit and integration tests for FolioValidator covering folios with null or missing nominee records.
recommendedActions.rationale: Ensures future nominee validation deployments do not fail on legacy folios without nominees.
recommendedActions.verification: Check CI build pipeline test reports for build-60433 test suites.

Because legacy-jenkins-mum records timestamps without a timezone offset, the recorded timestamp 09:20 represents 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC), which occurred 2 minutes prior to error onset at 03:52 UTC (09:22 IST). The on-call SRE misread 09:20 as UTC (14:50 IST) and mistakenly ruled it out.

No other deployments, configuration changes, or schema updates occurred across bank-connector, database, debit-worker, mandate-service, or payment-service between 2026-10-20 00:00 UTC and 10:15 UTC, nor in the preceding 24 hours.

Historical incidents for SIP issues include PIR-1114 (partner bank batch debit delay) and PIR-1784 (duplicate SIP reminder notifications); no past incidents directly relate to mf-order-service order validation failures or nominee checks.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Fund order errors since morning

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-20 at approximately 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC), mutual fund orders on mf-order-service experienced an elevated error rate of ~6.3%, predominantly affecting SIP orders. Investigation revealed that deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 to v4.1.0) rolled out via legacy-jenkins-mum at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introduced a regression in FolioValidator.validateNominee, which threw unhandled NullPointerExceptions for folios lacking nominee records. The on-call SRE initially dismissed the deployment because legacy-jenkins-mum logged timestamps without an explicit timezone offset, leading the team to misinterpret 09:20 local time as 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST).

**Root cause:** Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service (version 4.1.0) at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) introduced nominee validation logic for SIP orders that fails with an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever an existing folio has no associated nominee record.

## Hypotheses
1. **mf-order-service release v4.1.0 (CHG-48219: nominee validation for SIP orders) introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without a nominee record.** — `mf-order-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_17] · Contradicting: none
   - Deployment CHG-48219 took place at 09:20:00 IST (03:50:00 UTC). Exactly two minutes later at 03:52:07 UTC, mf-order-service v4.1.0 began logging HTTP 500 errors stating 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' across 1,293 instances, driving error rate from 0.3% to ~6.3%.
2. **Upstream RTA API degradation or slow acknowledgements are causing SIP order submission failures.** — `mf-order-service`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1] · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_4, ev_17]
   - RTA logs showed only routine slow acknowledgement warnings and cut-off notifications without submission error surges. The order failures are internal 500 errors caused by local NullPointerExceptions before or during validation, not upstream network or API failures.

## Facts
- Deployment CHG-48219 for mf-order-service updated version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0 ('release: nominee validation for SIP orders') via legacy-jenkins-mum with timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 (tz: 'none'). [ev_4]
- Between 03:52:07 UTC and 10:14:53 UTC, mf-order-service logged 1,293 HTTP 500 errors with message 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)', all emitting from version 4.1.0. [ev_1, ev_3]
- mf-order-service error_rate rose from baseline ~0.30% to 2.71% at 03:45 UTC and settled at ~6.30% - 6.32% from 04:00 UTC onwards. [ev_17]
- Downstream payment and debit services (bank-connector, debit-worker, mandate-service, payment-service) maintained baseline error rates between 0.4% and 1.0% with no spikes. [ev_2, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_11, ev_12]
- api-gateway routes for /v1/sip and /v1/orders showed no elevated error rate and maintained baseline between 0.25% and 0.40%. [ev_13, ev_15]

## Inferences
- The legacy-jenkins-mum deployer recorded the deployment timestamp in local IST (09:20:00 IST = 03:50:00 UTC) without a timezone offset, which the SRE mistakenly interpreted as UTC (14:50 IST), leading to prematurely ruling out the deployment. [ev_4]
- The failure is strictly isolated to SIP orders placed against existing folios lacking nominee records, while lumpsum purchases and redemptions remain unaffected. [ev_1, ev_3]

## Assumptions
- legacy-jenkins-mum host clock operates on Asia/Kolkata (IST, UTC+05:30) time.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-20 09:20:00 IST (03:50:00 UTC)** mf-order-service deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) completed by legacy-jenkins-mum. [ev_4]
- **2026-10-20 09:22:07 IST (03:52:07 UTC)** First observed NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee on mf-order-service v4.1.0. [ev_1, ev_3]
- **2026-10-20 09:30:00 IST (04:00:00 UTC)** mf-order-service error_rate metric escalates to ~6.30% steady state. [ev_17]
- **2026-10-20 15:40:00 IST (10:10:00 UTC)** Incident INC-9077 opened by on-call SRE; deployment was mistakenly ruled out due to timestamp confusion. [ev_4]

## Confidence
0.95: Direct log stack traces show v4.1.0 throwing NullPointerExceptions in the exact nominee validation feature shipped in CHG-48219, starting two minutes after deploy completion.

## Gaps
- Commit diff for build-60433 / CHG-48219 could not be directly inspected via git tool. (impact: Low; the error message explicitly names FolioValidator.validateNominee and identifies the null nominee record on folio objects.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Roll back mf-order-service to version 4.0.7 immediately or hotfix FolioValidator.validateNominee to handle null nominee records gracefully. [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_17]
  - Why: Restores SIP order placement functionality for folios without nominee data.
  - Verify: Monitor mf-order-service error_rate metric to confirm it drops from 6.3% back to ~0.3%, and verify error logs cease.
- **[next]** Configure legacy-jenkins-mum to emit ISO-8601 timestamps with explicit timezone offsets (+05:30 or Z). [ev_4]
  - Why: Prevents incident responders from misinterpreting local deployment times as UTC.
  - Verify: Inspect change record metadata in get_changes for future builds from legacy-jenkins-mum.
- **[later]** Add regression unit and integration tests for FolioValidator covering folios with null or missing nominee records. [ev_1, ev_3]
  - Why: Ensures future nominee validation deployments do not fail on legacy folios without nominees.
  - Verify: Check CI build pipeline test reports for build-60433 test suites.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_11, ev_12, ev_13, ev_15, ev_17
Investigation window: 2026-10-20 08:30 IST to 2026-10-20 15:45 IST
